listed.text: Implement or fix QRick generation, camera scanning, shared panel UI, bookmarklet behavior, and extension entry points. Use for application changes in this repository, rather than store-only preparation or test-only investigation.

Prepare or review QRick release bundles, store listings, privacy disclosures, screenshots, licenses, and reproducible source archives. Use for local packaging and publication readiness; publishing, signing, tagging, and pushing follow the user's explicit requested scope.

Diagnose QRick bugs and verify camera behavior, popup layout, bookmarklet artifacts, and local browser extensions. Use for test selection, browser MCP investigation, and regression checks; store submission preparation belongs to qrick-release.
